topics.topic: Whether standing grants can authorize effect sends/resends without fresh per-send approval (including draft-write cases)
questions: When an effect is being sent again (or re-sent with changed built request) and a standing grant is active, does the grant authorize the send without fresh approval, or is fresh approval always required for repeats?

Can a StandingGrant be created for a draft-write node, and if yes does it have any authority effect on sends (or is draft-write always authorized only by flow activation except resend-after-not_applied)?

quotes:
An effect resolved as not applied is sent again only with a fresh
approval, even where a standing approval exists.

A difference voids the approval, not a
standing grant: where the owner's active grant covers the node, the send
goes under the grant without asking (A10 rule 1; owner, 2026-10-03, raised
by State 2 round 30).

- `authority`: the approval or the grant it used, or for a `draft-write` send
  the flow activation under which the run started (State 2, A10 rule 6; State
  5) — except a resend after `not_applied`, which, whatever its class, records
  the fresh approval it needed;
a `destructive` node or a version that is not active cannot be granted; revoking where no grant is active is refused
judgement.why: The text already specifies when grants can authorize sends, the resend-after-not_applied exception requiring fresh approval, and that draft-write uses flow activation authority except that same resend exception.

topics.topic: Behavior of ManifestOperation reads when no service instance is selected
questions: When no instance is selected for a service, is ManifestOperation still read, and if so is base_url absent as an instance fact (like required_headers/instance_class), or is ManifestOperation read refused altogether?

topics.topic: How individual FlowActivation instances are uniquely identified and referenced across records/audit
questions: How is one specific FlowActivation record identified and referenced (especially by EffectAttempt for `draft-write` and for audit), when the same flow version can be activated multiple times?

topics.topic: Scope of explicit actor attribution required on persisted records
questions: Must every persisted record explicitly carry an Actor, or is actor attribution required only on selected records (creator/decider/starter), with others implicitly kernel-authored?

topics.topic: Timestamp semantics when an EffectAttempt transitions from unknown to resolved
questions: When an `unknown` attempt is later resolved, what timestamp semantics are required: does `concluded_at` change, or is resolution time stored separately?

topics.topic: What constitutes AdmissionVerdict identity/value facts (include TrialExecution refs or only implementation_id+corpus_digest)
questions: Are TrialExecution references part of the AdmissionVerdict's value facts, or is the verdict uniquely the pair (implementation_id, corpus_digest) regardless of which TrialExecution records were produced on reruns?

topics.topic: When FlowActivation records are created for proven read-only flow versions (prove-time vs explicit activate call)
questions: For a proven read-only flow version, is FlowActivation created automatically at prove time, or only when someone calls activate?

topics.topic: Whether and how agents may read implementation code via inspect outside repair context
questions: Can an agent read implementation code via inspect outside the repair context, and if so under what scope?
